caption: Fig. 3: Overview of UniGraph construction for one center base vector pair x x . Across sampled α \alpha values ranging from the sparse (lexical) endpoint to the dense (semantic) endpoint, the construction retains the top- k g k_{g} hybrid neighbors of x x at each weight; the illustration uses k g = 3 k_{g}=3 . The per- α \alpha lists are merged and deduplicated, and the number in parentheses indicates each candidate’s occurrence frequency. Ranking the candidates by this frequency produces a single UniGraph neighborhood that favors neighbors selected across multiple dense-sparse trade-offs.
